construction: Equal-weighted, monthly-rebalanced, buy-and-hold between rebalances; dated membership changes take effect same-day. Benchmark = S&P/TSX Composite (XIC.TO).
history_note: Series before a basket's creation date are a backtest of the membership as of creation; live tracking starts at creation. Universe = the canada_search S&P/TSX Composite cache (~5y).
note: Curated S&P/TSX thematic baskets — hindsight-curated and descriptive, not an out-of-sample backtest and not a buy list.

ca_banks.name: Big Banks
ca_banks.thesis: The backbone of the TSX — the Big-Five chartered banks plus the alt-lenders. Oligopoly economics, fat dividends and a direct read on Canadian credit, mortgages and net-interest-margin. The index's largest single bloc.
ca_banks.thesis_zh: 多伦多交易所的支柱 — 五大特许银行加另类贷款机构。寡头经济、丰厚分红，直接反映加拿大信贷、按揭与净息差。指数中最大的单一板块。

members.name: Royal Bank Of Canada
members.rationale: Royal Bank — the largest Canadian bank

changelog.note: Seeded Big Banks — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_insurers.name: Insurers
ca_insurers.thesis: The big lifecos and P&C insurers — earnings and book value geared to equity markets, long-bond yields and Asia/US growth. A rate-sensitive financial sleeve distinct from the banks.
ca_insurers.thesis_zh: 大型寿险与财险公司 — 利润与净资产挂钩权益市场、长债收益率及亚洲/美国增长。区别于银行、对利率敏感的金融板块。

ca_asset_mgrs.name: Asset Managers & Alternatives
ca_asset_mgrs.thesis: Canada's alternative-asset and holding-company complex — the Brookfield empire, Power, Onex, the fund managers and the exchange. Levered to fee-bearing capital, deal flow and private-market valuations.
ca_asset_mgrs.thesis_zh: 加拿大的另类资产与控股公司集群 — 博枫体系、Power、Onex、基金管理人与交易所。受管理费资本、交易活动与私募市场估值驱动。

members.name: Brookfield Business Corp Class A
members.rationale: Brookfield Business — listed PE / business services

changelog.note: Seeded Asset Managers & Alternatives — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_gold.name: Gold Miners
ca_gold.thesis: The TSX's signature theme — senior and mid-tier gold producers levered to the bullion price, central-bank buying and the real-rate / de-dollarization narrative. High operating leverage to gold.
ca_gold.thesis_zh: 多交所的标志性主题 — 大型与中型金矿生产商，受金价、央行购金与实际利率/去美元化叙事驱动。对金价具高经营杠杆。

changelog.note: Seeded Gold Miners — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_silver_royalty.name: Silver & Royalties
ca_silver_royalty.thesis: The capital-light royalty/streaming names plus the silver producers — leverage to precious-metals prices with lower operating risk (royalties) or higher beta (silver). A complement to the gold-miner basket.
ca_silver_royalty.thesis_zh: 轻资产的特许权/流式金融公司加白银生产商 — 以更低经营风险（特许权）或更高弹性（白银）押注贵金属价格。黄金矿业篮子的补充。

changelog.note: Seeded Silver & Royalties — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_oil_gas.name: Oil & Gas Producers
ca_oil_gas.thesis: The oil-sands integrators and the gas/light-oil E&Ps — heavy free-cash-flow returned via buybacks and dividends. The TSX's leveraged play on WTI/WCS spreads and natural-gas prices.
ca_oil_gas.thesis_zh: 油砂一体化企业与天然气/轻油勘探生产商 — 充沛自由现金流，通过回购与分红回馈。多交所押注 WTI/WCS 价差与天然气价格的杠杆腿。

members.name: Baytex Energy Corp
members.rationale: Baytex Energy — heavy oil + Eagle Ford

changelog.note: Seeded Oil & Gas Producers — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_pipelines.name: Pipelines & Midstream
ca_pipelines.thesis: The energy-infrastructure toll-takers — pipelines, gas processing and midstream. Long-life, fee-based cash flows and big dividends; a lower-beta, rate-sensitive income complement to the producers.
ca_pipelines.thesis_zh: 能源基建的'收费站' — 管道、天然气处理与中游。长久期、基于费用的现金流与高分红；相对生产商更低 Beta、对利率敏感的收息补充。

changelog.note: Seeded Pipelines & Midstream — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_uranium.name: Uranium & Nuclear
ca_uranium.thesis: Canada's uranium complex — the dominant producer plus the development names. A high-beta play on the nuclear-renaissance / power-demand thesis and the uranium price; an iconic TSX resource theme.
ca_uranium.thesis_zh: 加拿大铀产业链 — 龙头生产商加开发型公司。押注核能复兴/电力需求与铀价的高弹性主题；多交所标志性的资源主题。

changelog.note: Seeded Uranium & Nuclear — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_base_metals.name: Base Metals & Copper
ca_base_metals.thesis: Copper and diversified base-metal miners — leverage to the global growth cycle, electrification demand and supply discipline. The cyclical, China-sensitive end of the TSX materials complex.
ca_base_metals.thesis_zh: 铜与多元化基本金属矿企 — 受全球增长周期、电气化需求与供给约束驱动。多交所材料板块中周期性、对中国敏感的一端。

changelog.note: Seeded Base Metals & Copper — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_materials.name: Fertilizer, Chemicals & Forestry
ca_materials.thesis: The non-metal materials sleeve — the global potash/nitrogen leader, methanol, lumber and specialty packaging. Levered to crop prices, housing and the industrial cycle.
ca_materials.thesis_zh: 非金属材料板块 — 全球钾肥/氮肥龙头、甲醇、木材与特种包装。受农产品价格、住房与工业周期驱动。

members.name: Labrador Iron Ore Royalty Corp
members.rationale: Labrador Iron Ore Royalty — iron-ore royalty

changelog.note: Seeded Fertilizer, Chemicals & Forestry — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_rails_ind.name: Rails & Industrials
ca_rails_ind.thesis: The transport & industrial backbone — the two transcontinental railways, waste, engineering and equipment names. Steady compounders geared to North American freight, infrastructure and capex.
ca_rails_ind.thesis_zh: 运输与工业骨干 — 两大横贯铁路、固废、工程与设备公司。稳健复利型企业，受北美货运、基建与资本开支驱动。

changelog.note: Seeded Rails & Industrials — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_tech.name: Technology
ca_tech.thesis: Canada's tech leaders — the e-commerce platform, the serial software acquirer, electronics manufacturing and the SaaS names. The TSX's growth engine, dominated by Shopify and Constellation.
ca_tech.thesis_zh: 加拿大科技龙头 — 电商平台、连环软件并购方、电子制造与 SaaS 公司。多交所的成长引擎，由 Shopify 与 Constellation 主导。

ca_utilities.name: Utilities & Renewables
ca_utilities.name_zh: 公用事业与可再生能源
ca_utilities.thesis: Regulated power & gas utilities plus the renewable-power developers — long-duration, bond-proxy cash flows and dividend growth. A rate-sensitive defensive anchor with a green-energy growth tail.
ca_utilities.thesis_zh: 受监管的电力与燃气公用事业加可再生能源开发商 — 长久期、债券替代型现金流与股息增长。对利率敏感的防御锚，兼具绿色能源成长尾部。

changelog.note: Seeded Utilities & Renewables — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_telecom.name: Telecom
ca_telecom.thesis: The Canadian telecom oligopoly — wireless + broadband incumbents with high dividends, now wrestling with price competition and heavy capex. A defensive, rate-sensitive income sleeve.
ca_telecom.thesis_zh: 加拿大电信寡头 — 高分红的无线+宽带巨头，正应对价格竞争与高资本开支。防御性、对利率敏感的收息板块。

ca_consumer.name: Consumer Staples & Retail
ca_consumer.thesis: Defensive consumption — the grocers, the global convenience-store roll-up, the dollar-store and the QSR franchisor. Steady, recession-resilient compounders with pricing power.
ca_consumer.thesis_zh: 防御性消费 — 杂货商、全球便利店整合者、一元店与快餐特许经营商。稳健、抗衰退、具提价能力的复利型企业。

changelog.note: Seeded Consumer Staples & Retail — equal-weight TSX members.

ca_reits.name: REITs
ca_reits.thesis: The Canadian REIT complex — retail, apartment, industrial and diversified landlords. Distribution-yield vehicles highly sensitive to bond yields and the rate cycle; a real-asset income sleeve.
ca_reits.thesis_zh: 加拿大 REIT 板块 — 零售、公寓、工业与多元化地产商。以派息为主、对债券收益率与利率周期高度敏感；实物资产收息板块。

members.name: First Capital Realty Real Estate I
